text_block_list.text: Голд Сити doesn't show up for training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I got a call from a store I'm a regular at,
saying
they had some new items in...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And, well, I got so excited talking about
outfits, I
completely lost track of time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити apologizes again, and I give
her a firm
reminder to be careful next
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
